name: Clan Dromoka
description: The former Abzan clan, renamed under Dromoka's rule and organized around dragons.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan over necromancy until Khan Daghatar is brought before her; he ends the kin-tree traditions and pacts with dragons.
timeline.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons

relations.quote: Under the Elder Dragonlord Dromoka, the Abzan name was forgotten, and the group became known as clan Dromoka.
